name: @d4n/tokens
description: Data4Now design tokens — the four-tier source of truth for the JupyterLab distribution
//: Deliberately NOT a labextension — note the absent `jupyterlab` key. This package is a build-time library: it generates the CSS the theme packages ship and the typed values the T4 bridges read. It has no plugin and registers nothing, which is why scripts/run-workspaces.mjs skips it for build:labextension.
